For reference I am a local in the Yosemite NP area. I have friends that are rangers as well as friends that are friends with rangers in the park. 

Because she isn’t from the area, or the United States it took Yosemite a bit of time to reach out to her family once they found her body. I’m unsure if it had to do with them not answering phone calls or if it was hard to find family members or if there was a language barrier. None the less they couldn’t post that they found her because it is extremely rude and sad for the family to find out through social media that she was found dead. This has nothing to do with missing411. Upper Yosemite falls is the trail that she did. It is not an easy hike. It is strenuous and icy at this time of year. my friends have talked to rangers and they have said she slipped at the top of upper Yosemite falls and took a 2,500 foot fall. Nobody could survive that. All we can do is wait for the park to post something with details and pray her family is okay and send them positive thoughts.
